0022600164.text: The Sacramento Kings enter this game 0-5 after five straight losses, including an 0-3 road record, and sit 5th in the Pacific, 3.5 games back. They are without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while the Dallas Mavericks, 4-2 and on a three-game winning streak, are missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Sacramento won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 130-121 win in Dallas on February 26, 2026.
